title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 2: Battle Tendency
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In 1938, brash Joseph Joestar, grandson of Part 1's Jonathan, learns that ancient 'Pillar Men', immortal beings who feed on life and fear sunlight, are awakening. With rival-turned-friend Caesar Zeppeli and the stern master Lisa Lisa, he trains in Hamon, a sunlight-based breathing art, and battles the Pillar Men across Mexico, Rome and Switzerland, sometimes alongside a Nazi officer, to stop Kars from becoming an ultimate being.
life_message: It holds up courage, quick wits and honoring a family's legacy and fallen friends.

content.note: Bloody supernatural fights, impalements and bodies torn apart; Caesar's sacrificial death (Wikipedia; CSM on the anime; AniList Gore 66%).
Body-horror Pillar Men who absorb people, vampires and zombies (Wikipedia; AniList Vampire 78%, Body Horror signal).
Occasional implied nudity and muscular, revealing designs (CSM on the franchise; MangaUpdates Nudity). No sexual plot (to verify).
Joseph's trash talk; CSM says strong language is rare in the early seasons.
Adults drink and smoke at times (CSM on the franchise; to verify for Part 2).
Straizo destroys himself with Hamon rather than be defeated; grief over Caesar (Wikipedia).
Joseph's tricks and taunts; fantastical powers hard to imitate.
Large franchise with games and merchandise (CSM).
